name: Starburned
source:
It has been quite an eventful year for Opal Yazzie. After moving to a new school for superhumans and her closest friend going missing, all Opal wants is a normal last week of school. 

But when her and her crush, Clara Stilton, are faced with an unexpected visitor, she is soon to realize that her last week will be anything but normal.

[From [url=https://cosmiccorpse.itch.io/starburned-chapter-one]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
对于Opal Yazzie来说，这是多事的一年。搬到一所新的超人学校，而她最亲密的朋友失踪后，奥帕尔想要的只是在学校的最后一周恢复正常。

但当她和她的暗恋对象克拉拉·斯蒂尔顿 (Clara Stilton) 遇到一位不速之客时，她很快就意识到，她的最后一周绝非正常。

[来自[url=https://cosmiccorpse.itch.io/starburned-chapter-one]Itch.io[/url]]
